messages.content:
Risk: Information Integrity
Description: Lowered barrier to entry to generate and support the exchange and consumption of content which may not distinguish fact from opinion or fiction or acknowledge uncertainties, or could be leveraged for large-scale dis- and mis-information campaigns.
Concern: None
Policy: Misinformation

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/Markets/ApprovedPublicationArrangement: approved publication arrangement — data reporting services provider that is authorized to provide the service of publishing certain trade reports on behalf of banks, investment firms, or asset management companies [found by 24/91 queries]
  Siblings: approved reporting mechanism, consolidated tape provider
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/Markets/ApprovedReportingMechanism: approved reporting mechanism — data reporting services provider that is authorized to provide the service of reporting details of transactions to competent authorities or ESMA (the European Securities and Markets Authority) on behalf of investment firms [found by 20/91 queries]
  Siblings: approved publication arrangement, consolidated tape provider
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001045: Artifact Model — A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes a common set of Functions and Qualities to inhere in a set of artifact instances. [found by 20/91 queries]
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000592: Veracity Measurement Information Content Entity — A Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of the extent to which a description conforms to the reality it describes. [found by 15/91 queries]
  Siblings: Deviation Measurement Information Content Entity, Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity, Interval Measurement Information Content Entity
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/RegulatoryAgencies/RegulatoryReport: regulatory report — document required to support operational transparency that demonstrates compliance with some specification, law, policy, restriction, or other rule specified by a regulatory agency [found by 13/91 queries]
  Siblings: technical specification document, registry, transaction record

axes.rationale: This class represents the measurement of the extent to which a description conforms to reality, which is directly relevant to the risk of misinformation and the integrity of information.
This class involves the authorized publication of trade reports, which can be relevant in the context of ensuring the integrity and authenticity of information being disseminated.
